changelog:
Initial release of agentic-powered-memecoin-trader skill, enabling headless memecoin trading with AI agent control.

- Supports running fdv.lol in CLI mode with Agent Gary "Full AI Control" for autonomous trading decisions.
- Includes a safe example profile template for user configuration (no real secrets included).
- Automated first-run onboarding wizard: generates new wallet, guides user to provide required RPC & API keys, and validates AI API key for full agent control.
- Enforces strict local handling of sensitive information; never uploads or publishes user secrets.
- Documents minimum profile requirements and runtime parameters for secure, fully agent-driven operation.
display_name: Agent Gary AI Powered Memecoin trader.
summary: Automates memecoin trading on Solana using fdv.lol CLI with Agent Gary's AI full control via a locally generated, user-configured profile.
